text:
- Build personal Reading Lists from selected issue, series and creator search results.
- Choose reading alternatives from separately named cards. Follow the 69-issue Secret Wars fast track or save its Doomsday companion under its own name.
- Explore owner-selected MCU Prep guides for Fantastic Four: First Steps, Eternals, Deadpool & Wolverine, Daredevil, Moon Knight, Thunderbolts* and Shang-Chi.
- Keep finished Reading Lists in All completed or Enjoyed, reopen them whenever you want, keep optional thumbs private and find verified related next reads.
- Open quiet What's new highlights on Home when you want to see included improvements and new Reading Lists.
- Keep Read and Done, next together, with secondary actions disclosed and simpler phone navigation.
- Keep existing reading data and reader backups compatible. Completion and enjoyment use a separate history backup: export both backup types before moving them. Keep the same local address and browser profile.
